अदेय अ-देय, अस्, आ, अम्, improper or unfit
to be given; (अम्), n. an object which, in law, it is
either not right or not necessary to give or surrender.
—अदेय-दान, अम्, n. an illegal gift.

आ-देय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be taken or received, re-
ceivable, leviable.
आदेय आ-देय. See under 1. आ-दा last page.

अदेव अ-देव, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. दिव्), not divine,
not of divine origin, not referring to any deity; godless,
impious; (अस्), m. one who is not a god.
—अदेव-
मातृक, अस्, आ, अम्, not having the gods as mothers,
not suckled by any deity, i. e. not rained upon.

अ-देवक, अस्, आ, अम्, not referring to or intended
for any deity.

आदेवक आ-देवक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. rt. दिव् with
आ), one who sports or plays.
अ-देवता, f. one who is not a deity.

अ-देवत्र or अ-देवत्रा, ind., Ved. not towards
the gods.

अ-देवयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, or अदेवयु, उस्, उस्, उ,
Ved. indifferent to the gods, irreligious.

अदेवृघ्नी अ-देवृ-घ्नी, f., Ved. not de-
structive to her brother-in-law.

अदेश अ-देश, अस्, m. (rt. दिश्), a wrong place,
an improper place.
—अ-देश-काल, अम्, n. wrong
place and time.
—अदेश-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, grown in a
wrong place.
—अदेश-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, out of place,
in the wrong place, one absent from his country, an
absentee.

आ-देश, अस्, m. account, information; advice, in-
struction, precept, rule; an order, command; fore-
telling; (in gram.) a substitute, substituted form or
[]
letter, &c.; (in astrology) event, result, consequence
of stellar conjunctions.
—आदेश-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, obe-
dient.

अ-देश्य, अस्, आ, अम्, improper or unfit to be or-
dered or advised or indicated; not on the spot, not
present on the occasion referred to.
आ-देश्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be ordered or commanded.

आ-देशन, अम्, n. the act of instructing, command-
ing or prescribing.

आ-देशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, ordering, commanding, insti-
gating, exciting (e. g. कपोल-पाटलादेशिन्, exciting
a glow on the cheek); (ई), m. a commander, a
director; an astrologer, a fortune-teller.

आ-देष्टृ, टा, m. an adviser, a director, a com-
mander; an employer of priests.
आ-देवन, अम्, n. a place for playing.
